[[Cerise Island]] }} '''Punching Poliwrath''' (Japanese: '''VSニョロボン''' ''VS {{tt|Nyorobon|Poliwrath}}'') is the 66th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 26th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} The chapter begins with [[Daisy Oak]] taking care of a {{p|Wigglytuff}}. Suddenly, {{Adv|Professor Oak}} comes in, outraged with what is happening to [[Pewter City]], [[Cerulean City]], and [[Celadon City]]. Oak looks out of the lab at the burning cities as [[Misty]] is trying to defeat multiple {{p|Gengar}} in Cerulean City. Meanwhile on [[Cerise Island]], {{Adv|Blue}}, his {{TP|Blue|Golduck}}, and {{adv|Blaine}} meet with [[Lt. Surge]] and his {{p|Electabuzz}}, [[Sabrina]] and her {{p|Alakazam}}, and [[Koga]] and his {{p|Muk}}. Farther in the island, [[Lance]] orders [[Lorelei]] to call [[Bruno]] (who is looking to challenge {{adv|Red}} back). Meanwhile, Bruno has a flashback about his battle with Red. In the flashback, Red is calling Bruno, when suddenly the cliff he is on breaks. Bruno sends out his {{p|Hitmonlee}}, and it battles [[Pika]]. Pika is defeated and Hitmonlee is called back. Red sends out [[Poli]] and Bruno sends out {{p|Hitmonchan}}. Using {{m|Thunder Punch}} and {{m|Fire Punch}}, Poli is defeated. Now it is [[Gyara]] vs. {{TP|Bruno|Onix}}. As the two battle, Lorelei has a flashback about how she and [[Agatha]] met. ==Major events== * [[Misty]] tries to save her city from the {{TP|Agatha|Gengar}}. * In a flashback, the battle between {{Adv|Red}} and [[Bruno]] starts. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Wigglytuff}} * {{p|Chansey}} * {{p|Hitmonchan}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Adv|Red}} * {{Adv|Blue}} * {{Adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Professor Oak}} * {{adv|Blaine}} * [[Misty]] * [[Lt.
